question: Characterize recall/FN, review workload, ranking and low scores for a human-decision risk-score service; FPR is reported, never an exclusion gate.
scope: Saved scores only. No training, model inference, probability calibration fit, Test677 raw access, malware execution, remote write, or product policy.
threshold_rule: score >= fixed threshold; no threshold chosen from outer results; all grid points reported
ranking: Within each outer model/fold only. k=ceil(fraction*n). At the exact score tie boundary report exact-k malicious/normal capture minimum and maximum plus tie-all workload. Do not pick a favorable tie order. Pooled fold-quota totals sum fold counts/ranges and do not rank mixed OOF scores.
low_rule: score <= cutoff, independent diagnostic with inclusive boundary; can overlap positive score>=t at exact equality; not a safe verdict
bin_rule: left-inclusive and right-exclusive except final bin includes 1; empty bin rates undefined
probability_diagnostics: Brier, clipped binary logloss, fixed 10-bin ECE, bin n/mean risk score/observed malicious fraction on outer only; unweighted empirical D06 cohort; no probability or calibration-success claim. Report fold and pooled bins separately and weighted fold ECE as a cancellation check.
recall_threshold_rule: Choose largest threshold from calibration malicious scores achieving requested recall using >= ties. Apply unchanged outer. No malicious calibration rows means unavailable. Examples are not adopted operating criteria; no normal FPR constraint.
report: fixed-threshold TP/FN/FP/TN and review-candidate count/rate; class and group breakdowns
fold-local ranking and pooled fold-quota capture bounds
low-score malicious count/all malicious fraction/low-bucket malicious fraction and groups
reliability bins and Brier/logloss/ECE with cohort and fit prevalences
calibration-recall operating examples and unchanged outer outcomes
saved scores, metadata, splits, source hashes, code/spec snapshots and verification
limits: D06 2767 rows is repeatedly inspected development data with malicious prevalence 928/2767, not deployment prevalence
same rows in two inner seeds, never pool seeds as independent observations
each fold/model has its own score scale; no pooled OOF ranking
score is labeled risk score, not malicious probability; weighted-model scores elsewhere cannot be assumed on a comparable probability scale
review candidates are not confirmed detections; no assumption of correct human review
unselected or low-score rows remain potential misses, never safe
A/B/C is a feature-derived proxy; groups do not guarantee independent attack families
no best threshold/model selected from outer metrics; no FPR ceiling rejects a candidate
